title: Category Navigation (Flat)
description: Header/category navigation, FLAT model. SAP typeCode CategoryNavigationComponent. Holds every node of the menu in a single all_nodes reference pool (an adjacency list); the connector reassembles the tree from each node's parent_id. Resolves in a constant, shallow include chain regardless of menu depth.

field_metadata.instruction: Optional: wrap the menu after N items.
The flat pool of every node in this menu (all levels). The connector builds the tree from each node's parent_id.
